servinfo.title: Parking Brake Cable Inspection

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Parking Brake Cable Removal and Installation

servinfo.ptxt: If check result is not OK, repair or replace defective parts.

item.ptxt: Check that parking brake cable clamps are properly positioned and free from any abnormal conditions.
Check that parking brake cable is not damaged or bent.
Push and pull parking brake inner cable from input side (1) and check that the other side (2) follows smoothly.
